evidence_quotes: Atividade degradadora do meio ambiente em áreas de preservação permanente ao longo da Bacia do Córrego dos Cubas
o TJ entende que as matas ciliares visam à preservação dos recursos hídricos
rationale: Public prosecutor environmental action concerning environmental degradation and recovery of riparian permanent preservation areas (APP / matas ciliares) along the Córrego dos Cubas basin, stream channelization with gabions, protection of water resources, and municipal master-plan detailing for basin water drainage. Substantively water/riparian environmental governance (environmental_protection) without household water/sanitation connection or informal-settlement service access issues.
